project_summary: Summary of requirements gathered from the engineering meeting on User Authentication and Password Resets, focusing on email communications, session extension handling, and detail verification.
identified_risks: Incomplete security specs regarding password reset token expiration and rate limiting.
Ambiguous requirements around session extension triggers and timeout thresholds.
Unclear definition of 'Priority level' and detail validation rules from raw notes.

user_stories.title: Password Reset via Email
user_stories.user_story: As a registered user, I want to receive a password reset link via email so that I can securely regain access to my account if I forget my credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registered user on the forgot password page, When they submit their email address, Then a secure reset link is emailed to them.
Given an expired password reset token, When the user clicks the link, Then an error message is displayed prompting them to request a new link.

user_stories.title: Session Extension
user_stories.user_story: As an authenticated user, I want my active session to be automatically extended while I am using the application so that I do not get unexpectedly logged out.
acceptance_criteria: Given an active user session, When user interaction occurs before session expiration, Then the session token expiration is extended.
Given an inactive session past the expiration limit, When the user attempts an action, Then they are redirected to the login page.
